review:
A 5x5, 19-line mad lab where the whole grid rotates. A RotoGrid symbol lands with one to four charges, each turning the grid 90 degrees clockwise, with paylines recalculated after every turn – so a spin that looked dead can suddenly win.

Mr. Melker and Pat the Rat run the lab, with nods to other Hacksaw characters like Canny and the Chaos Crew. Rated 4/5 with a 15,000x max. One of the studio's most original ideas.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
